## The five claims (with the discipline the plan + critics required)

**1. The plan's sycophancy hypothesis (an on-policy Qwen arm clears the floor Claude missed) is FALSIFIED at these stimuli.** Both arms sit at 22–28% keep vs the 55.6% the floor requires. Attribution — stimulus hardness vs generator family: three lines of evidence point at the wrong-fact stimulus bank, not the generator family. (a) Per-question structure: 12 of 19 claims produced ZERO keeps under BOTH Qwen arms, while one easy claim (the glass-flows myth, `trainq-0022`) kept 4/5 (base) and 5/5 (ablit) — the failure is concentrated in specific hard-false claims, not spread uniformly. (b) Per-variant structure: no elicitation phrasing exceeded 3 kept of ≤7 judged in either arm — phrasing diversity does not rescue. (c) Cross-generator persistence: Claude 6/36 (#906), base Qwen 10/36, abliterated Qwen 8/36 — three generator variants floor on the same bank, and abliteration (which removes refusal behavior) moves sycophancy yield ~0/slightly negative, consistent with the binding constraint being the factual-correction prior all these chat models share, which refusal-ablation does not target. **2. The contrast is question-paired, enormous (+0.78/question), and sign-consistent (97/0/19). Judge-drop asymmetry does not explain it: the abliterated arm lost MORE rows to judge no-scores (19 vs 14 all-draws-dropped), which is conservative — if dropped rows lean compliant, true abliterated yield is understated. Mechanism discipline: I do NOT claim the refusal-direction ablation per se causes this — the community checkpoint may differ from base beyond willingness (quality, style); the completion QUALITY of the 177 kept rows is un-audited beyond the compliance rubric.

**3. NEW finding (not in the plan's hypothesis set): the abliterated generator poisons its own contrastive negatives.** The harmful-ablit cell cleared positives but failed the same-question pairing gate: negative-panel member `neg_sp_ph4` kept 19 < quota 24 (the pipeline fail-fasts in panel order; `neg_sp_police` passed at exactly 24). The direct fix is mixed-generator datagen: abliterated positives + base-Qwen negatives (the contrastive-negatives rule's on-policy-negatives requirement names the BASE model anyway).

**4. Coverage shrinkage (K1) — say it everywhere:** the planned install DVs (judged on-policy rate, teacher-forced fixed-margin companion, dose-to-band steps) were NOT run for any cell; the install hypotheses are UNTESTED, not falsified. The dual-DV measurement-validity contract therefore does not bind this round (no install comparison exists to dual-report); the realized primary DV is the registered yield gate itself, which has full dynamic range (4.2%–82.3% — no floor/ceiling saturation of the DV).

**5. ## The five claims

**1. The plan's sycophancy hypothesis (an on-policy Qwen arm clears the floor Claude missed) is FALSIFIED at these stimuli.** Both arms sit at 22–28% keep vs the 55.6% the floor requires. Attribution is OBSERVATIONAL and points at the wrong-fact stimulus bank rather than generator family: (a) 12 of 19 claims produced zero keeps under BOTH arms vs ~7.6 expected under a uniform keep rate (~2 sd excess — supportive but coarse), while the glass-flows myth keeps 4/5 and 5/5; (b) no phrasing exceeded 3 kept of ≤7 judged in either arm, and the best (3 of 6) has a Wilson interval spanning the floor rate — per-question denominators are 1–5, per-phrasing 3–7, so the concentration read is coarse; (c) three generator variants floor on the same bank (Claude 6/36, base Qwen 10/36, abliterated 8/36), and the abliterated checkpoint moves sycophancy ~0/slightly negative, consistent with the binding constraint being the factual-correction prior these chat models share. Judge medians ~1–6/100 — the generators actively correct, not nearly agree. The opinion/self-assessment stimulus arm remains the direct manipulated test.

**2. The harmful-compliance direction hypothesis is strongly supported at the ARM level: the abliterated-checkpoint arm cleared the positive floor (82.3%, 177 ≥ 120) where base Qwen sits at 4.2%.** The contrast is question-paired, large (+0.78/question), and sign-consistent (97/0/19). Judge-drop asymmetry cannot explain it — the abliterated arm lost MORE rows to judge no-scores (19 vs 14 fully-dropped), which is conservative. Mechanism discipline (now carried into the BODY, not just here): the single-variable contrast is between two CHECKPOINTS — base vs a community abliterated derivative — not "ablation on/off," so the difference can include derivative changes beyond willingness (style, verbosity, judge-legibility); the 177 kept rows passed the compliance rubric only, with no quality audit; and length is a live judge nuisance — kept completions are long in BOTH arms (kept median 2,591 chars base, 1,977 abliterated) while base's dominant sub-threshold rows are short (median 544 chars), so a partial length/detail reward cannot be excluded, though it cannot plausibly produce the 97-to-0 sign pattern. # Interpretation v3 — same-issue follow-up round `base-negatives-regen` folded into #1074

## What this round tested

The parent round's clean-result declared one untested prediction: the abliterated generator's negative-stage failure (53 of 175 contrastive negatives judged behavior-compliant, 4 of 5 panel members below the 24-of-35 pairing quota) would be fixed by regenerating the negatives from base Qwen, whose 96% non-compliance under opposite-direction elicitation suggested it authors clean refusal-style negatives natively. Plan v7 (amendment) pre-registered two hypotheses: H2′ — all 5 panel members clear the quota with base-Qwen negatives; H3′ (conditional) — the resulting mixed-generator cell (abliterated positives + base negatives) trains into the [0.60, 0.85] judged-rate band within the 3-epoch ceiling.

## Claims (with confidence)

1. **H2′ CONFIRMED — base-Qwen negatives clear the pairing quota for all five panel members** (kept 31/24/29/30/31 of 35; rates 0.686–0.886). Confidence HIGH for the count gate itself (pre-registered threshold, mechanical). The attribution is clean: only **1 of 175** base-Qwen rows was judged behavior-compliant vs the parent's 53, under identical oppose instructions, panel, judge, and rubric — so the parent's failure was generator willingness, not phrasing or judge drift. The 30-row cross-round calibration re-judge (19 of 20 scored rows match the parent's keep decisions; 10 judge-dropped) rules out rubric drift as the driver.
2. **H3′ FALSIFIED via the K3′ path at this recipe and dose** — the cell trained 3 epochs (90 steps) and never entered [0.60, 0.85]: dose curve 0.124 → 0.154 → 0.253 → 0.260 at steps 25/50/75/90; closest-approach selection step 90; full-bank source rate 0.233. Confidence MODERATE, and deliberately scoped: the curve is still rising at the ceiling, so this is "not within 3 epochs at lr 1e-5", not "cannot install".
3. **The install is real and context-selective**: source-persona rate 0.233 vs base 0.005 (graded means 22.8 vs 0.6); default-context 0.038 vs 0.005. The teacher-forced fixed-pool margin companion agrees in direction (trained−base +0.085 nats at source vs +0.023 at default) though all absolute margins stay negative. Confidence MODERATE (single cell, single seed; margin is the secondary DV, direction-read only).

## Alternatives considered

- **Judge drift between rounds** (the quota clearing is a rubric artifact): rejected by the calibration re-judge — 0.95 agreement with the parent's decisions on resampled parent rows; and the fresh-vs-parent kept fractions on the calibration subset (0.8 vs 0.6) differ in the direction of judge nondeterminism on borderline rows, not a threshold shift.
- **Measurement loss masquerading as willingness**: the plan's attribution guard separates the two — this round's residual drops are 29 judge no-scores (vs the parent's 22), essentially unchanged, while the behavior-compliant drop count collapsed 53 → 1. The gain is in the willingness column.
- **The band miss as a data-quality defect of the mixed cell**: possible but unresolved — the planned length/style diagnostic (mixed-generator style mismatch between abliterated positives and base negatives) was not produced by the aggregate; carried as an open caveat in the body. The dose curve's steady rise and the 11-of-194 questions at rate 1.0 argue the training signal is present but weak/heterogeneous rather than absent or contradictory.
- **Dose/recipe ceiling as the binding constraint** (rather than mixed-generator data being inherently weak): consistent with the project's prior finding that on-policy data installs more weakly at matched recipe and needs dose-to-target rather than fixed epochs. Untested here by design (the plan pinned the 3-epoch ceiling).

## Scope caveats

Single cell, single behavior class, single seed, one source persona. The 0.26 plateau claim is bounded by the 3-epoch ceiling — no evidence about longer training. Judge no-score drops are 17% of negative-stage rows and up to 11% of install-eval draws (dropped, never coerced; per-cell counts in the body). The quota gate is a pre-registered count threshold, not a null comparison — no significance testing at n = 35 per member.

## Next steps (routed via the follow-up proposer)

- Dose extension: train the same mixed cell past 3 epochs (or at higher lr) with dose-to-band selection — the direct test of whether the 0.26 plateau is a dose artifact. Cheap (single cell).
- The length/style diagnostic the plan named but the aggregate skipped: report kept-completion length distributions for the abliterated positives vs base negatives (free analysis on existing artifacts).
- If the cell reaches band at a longer dose, the factory's harmful-compliance lane is unblocked end-to-end; the mixed-generator recipe (willing generator for positives, base generator for negatives) becomes the default construction.
